```{python}
import palmerpenguins
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from vetiver import VetiverModel
from vetiver import vetiver_pin_write
from pins import board_folder
```

## Get Data

Load the Palmer Penguins data and retain observations with complete values for the model outcome and predictors.

```{python}
df = palmerpenguins.load_penguins()

model_columns = [
    "bill_length_mm",
    "species",
    "sex",
    "body_mass_g",
]

model_df = df.dropna(subset=model_columns)
retained_n = len(model_df)
excluded_n = len(df) - len(model_df)
```

The model retains `{python} retained_n` of `{python} len(df)` observations and excludes `{python} excluded_n` observations with missing values in the model outcome or predictors.

## Define Model and Fit

Fit a linear regression predicting body mass from bill length, species, and sex. Convert categorical predictors into indicator variables.

```{python}
X = pd.get_dummies(model_df[["bill_length_mm", "species", "sex"]], drop_first=True)
y = model_df["body_mass_g"]

model = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
```

## Evaluate Model

Perform basic checks that the model ran successfully.

```{python}
print(f"Training R^2 {model.score(X, y)}")
print(f"Intercept {model.intercept_}")
print(f"Columns {X.columns}")
print(f"Coefficients {model.coef_}")
```

## Create a Vetiver Model

Vetiver is Posit's opinionated framework for packaging and publishing models, creating prediction APIs, and monitoring model performance. The `VetiverModel` class wraps a model and its metadata, including a description and prototype data.

```{python}
v = VetiverModel(model, model_name="penguin_model", prototype_data=X)
v.description
v.prototype
```

## Store and Version the Model

Store and version the model on a pins board. The board can use a local folder, Posit Connect, Amazon S3, and more. Writing the vetiver model to the board stores the binary model object and metadata like packages needed for prediction and the model’s input data prototype for checking new data.

```{python}
model_folder = "C:/Users/mpfol/OneDrive/Documents/penguin-artifacts/model"
model_board = board_folder(model_folder, allow_pickle_read=True)
vetiver_pin_write(model_board, v)
```

## Check: Load Saved Model and Predict

Test that the model can be loaded from the board in a new session. The model object and metadata are restored.

```{python}
loaded_v = VetiverModel.from_pin(model_board, "penguin_model")
loaded_v.description

new_penguin = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "bill_length_mm": [39.1],
        "species_Chinstrap": [False],
        "species_Gentoo": [False],
        "sex_male": [True],
    }
)

loaded_v.model.predict(new_penguin)
```
